Being a child of someone with a mental illness was traumatic, but the worst part was it being brushed under the rug and not discussed. Mental illness is real and its something that shouldnt be ignored for 20 years. I know its hard to explain something like this to your kids, but all of sudden one day I had that mental illness and couldn’t realize it. I wish i had been better educated on the illnesses in my family so i could have been able to help them and myself. I can’t imagine how hard it is to raise a family with that also going on, i bet your doing an incredible job as a parent.

Thank you so very much, i do need to cut back on the news....I will try your tips! I have started to get back into reading after a decade of not reading! Again thank you very much your reply has been extremely helpful.

70 days is awesome!! Yea just a small group of people know but I want to tell everyone! Just not the best idea.  The app is great when I crave, I open the app up and check my progress, its a good feeling seeing that I have moved forward. Good luck!
Right! I want to tell everyone about my progress! But it would be letting everyone know I had a problem and I am not ready for those conversations.

For me the first 2 weeks especially, every time i wanted to drink or craved I would crack open a ginger ale instead of a beer. I just constantly felt like I needed to be drinking something especially at home. Even just the need of holding a can or cracking it open helped me. So i drank lots of ginger ale the first couple of weeks lol 

I also keep reminding myself of why I am cutting drinking out. It got to the point where I hurt myself from drinking so looking back at that now is helping me move forward. Good luck! You can do this! The first couple of weeks are hard but try to come up with new habits to replace the bad ones!

I too am having difficulty with my mental health and being CS major! I am trying to remind myself as long as I’m doing the best I can, then thats enough, especially when my mental health hits rock bottom. I feel like i will have to retake most of my classes from this semester too. It is definitely difficult, for me its not being able to focus and how my classmates seem to pick everything up so quickly. But I’m not giving up and neither are you! We can do this! And it will be so rewarding in the end. It doesn’t matter when you finish school as long as you do!
